case_name: Ghusabhai Raisangbhai Chorasiya and others v State of Gujarat
respondent:
State of Gujarat
Supreme Court of India

18 February 2015
Cr.A. No. 262 of 2009
The Judgment was delivered by : Dipak Misra, J.
1. The present appeal, by special leave, is directed against the judgment of conviction and order of sentence passed by the High Court of Gujarat at Ahmedabad in Criminal Appeal No. 444/2005 whereby the Division Bench has affirmed the conviction recorded by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Jamnagar, who had found the appellants guilty of the offences punishable under Section 498A, 306, 201 and 114 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ('IPC' for short) and sentenced Ghusabhai Raisinghbhai Chorasia, appellant no.1 to suffer five years imprisonment, Rakesh Ghusabhai Chorasia, appellant no.2 to suffer rigorous imprisonment for seven years and to pay a fine of Rs.500/- with a default clause and other accused persons, namely, Bakuben W/o Ghusabhai Chorasia and Jasuben @ Gaduben Rakeshbhai, appellant nos. 3 and 4 herein to
holding: The accused-appellants are not guilty of the offence u/s. 306 and 498A IPC.
The conviction under S. 201 IPC is also not sustainable.
